seo.title: Free Couple Quiz Online: Test Your Relationship Together
seo.description: Discover our free couple quizzes! Test your relationship, strengthen your bond and have fun together. No registration required, instant results.
seo.schemaDescription: Free quiz platform to test and strengthen your couple relationship

hero.title: Test your relationship with our
hero.description: Discover your level of compatibility, explore your connection and have fun together with our interactive quizzes.

quizSection.title: Our free quizzes for
quizSection.description: Choose the quiz that suits you and learn more about your relationship. All our quizzes are free, no registration required, and results are immediate!

questionsCard.title: 120 questions for couples
questionsCard.subtitle: Discover them for your evenings together

whatIs.title: What is a
whatIs.paragraph1End: designed especially for romantic partners. It allows you to evaluate different aspects of your relationship: communication, intimacy, common projects, and much more.
whatIs.paragraph2: Our quizzes are designed to be
whatIs.paragraph2End: . Far from complex psychological tests, they offer you a moment of complicity to share together.

whyDoQuiz.title: What these quizzes
whyDoQuiz.subtitle: Six good reasons to pick up the phone tonight instead of starting another series.

testRelation.title: Know where you stand
testRelation.description: Your strengths, your blind spots, and a score that sums it up. It's more honest than an end-of-evening conversation, and it takes five minutes.

haveFun.title: Have a proper evening
haveFun.description: Nothing to book, nothing to install. One phone, the two of you, and the evening takes a different turn.

discover.title: Learn something new
discover.description: Even after ten years, there are answers you have never heard. It's often the silliest question that brings them out.

strengthen.title: Get the spark back
strengthen.description: A round where you laugh and tease each other, the way you did at the start. The kind of moment that slips away as the weeks pile up.

dialogue.title: Say what goes unsaid
dialogue.description: Some subjects never come up on their own. A question asked by a screen lands better than a question asked by your partner.

memories.title: Keep something from it
memories.description: A result to share, a screenshot to send each other, and a conversation that carries on well past the last question.

choose.title: Choose
choose.description: A serious test or a light game, depending on the mood. Everything is free and nothing asks for an account.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Taking turns on the same phone, or each on your own. The questions come one at a time.

results.title: Find out
results.description: A detailed result, the advice that goes with it, and something to move on to next.

finalCTA.title: Ready to test your
finalCTA.description: Choose your favorite quiz and discover what makes your couple unique. It's free, no registration required, and it only takes a few minutes!
finalCTA.socialProofEnd: quizzes and tests taken by couples like you 💕

latestArticles.title: Latest articles
latestArticles.intro: In addition to the couple games you'll find on the site, we have a blog that we update as often as possible. Dating app reviews, relationship advice, or flirting tips, we diversify our content as much as we can, for you, with passion.
